channel.title: Chad - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Chad, every source cited.

item.title: Charity gives school kits to N'Djamena pupils
item.description: The Association de bienfaisance pour l’harmonie et le développement social donated supplies to La Sagesse school on October 31, 2026.

item.title: Chad land dispute halts N'Djamena health center construction
item.description: An association reports construction continues on land designated for a public health center in N'Djamena's Walia neighborhood.

item.title: Chad schedules Assoungha by-election for December 13
item.description: The National Election Management Agency announced the vote following the death of a member of the National Assembly.

item.title: Chad morgue registers over 300 deaths in October
item.description: The Markaz mosque morgue in N'Djamena processed more than 300 bodies, mostly from natural causes.

item.title: Chad health ministry reports 14 dengue deaths amid rising fatalities
item.description: Official figures from October 26 state 14 dengue deaths, while one mosque held 26 funerals on October 30.
